title: Kenyan Roast Wrap
description: A flavorful vegetarian wrap filled with roasted vegetables and served with a side of sweet potato fries.

ingredients.name: roast
ingredients.notes: sweet potato, peeled and cut into fries

instructions: Toss the sweet potato fries with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large skillet, heat 1/4 cup of olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced narutomaki to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cumin and coriander. Sprinkle over the narutomaki mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Warm a large tortilla in the oven for 30 seconds. Assemble the wrap by placing the narutomaki mixture on the tortilla, followed by a few sweet potato fries.
If desired, serve with a side of tzatziki sauce or a dollop of yogurt.
